name: Job Bank
business_model: free for employers and job seekers
ingest_methods: Direct employer posting;XML feed (inbound from boards, on request);XML feed (outbound to other sites, on request);embeddable widgets
notes: Delivered by Employment and Social Development Canada. About page cites 55,000 jobs advertised per month and 371,000 registered employers. Terms of use prohibit scripts, robots and scrapers. Postings run 21 days. No public posting API is described. XML feed access is by request with eligibility criteria. The open data dataset on open.canada.ca has not been verified yet.

name: Talent.com
notes: ATS partner page lists 150+ integrated ATS partners and routes new partners through a contact form. No public API documentation found. Enterprise page cites 35 million jobs in 78 countries (another stat block on the same page says 77). Homepage cites over 40 million jobs. Publisher program page requires a login.

name: Adzuna
notes: Free API key issued on registration. Terms say commercial analysis and resale of data need a written licence agreement, with a 14 day trial. Listings must carry Adzuna attribution. Country list not yet verified.

name: Jooble

name: Careerjet

name: Jobs.ca
niche: general (network of sector and regional sites)
notes: Describes itself as Canada's largest job network with 23 sites including ITjobs.ca, HRjob.ca and Healthcarejobs.ca. French sites run on emplois.ca. Job Sync subscriptions run from CAD 199 to 649 per month by company size. Manual postings cost CAD 325 per post. No API documentation found. Owner not stated.

notes: Part of the Jobs.ca network. French version at emploisinformatique.ca. Same pricing as Jobs.ca. No API documentation found.

name: CharityVillage
notes: Postings cost CAD 298 for nonprofits and CAD 398 for for-profits. Volunteer postings are free. Job packs and 6 and 12 month unlimited subscriptions are offered. No API or feed page found. Operator not stated on pages read.

name: Careers.Indigenous.Link

name: Connect Nonprofit Jobs
